changelog: Fix: manifest.json inside the 1.10.2 ZIP still declared runtime entry 'fast.js', which is not in the ZIP — the package inspector found zero matching entry files. Both manifests now declare 'index.js'.

Fix: 1.10.x is now shipped as a proper module ZIP (index.js + module.json + manifest.json, same layout as 1.9.2) so the app's package inspector accepts it — the raw fast.js file failed install with 'module entry count invalid'.
Fix: non-YouTube track IDs (song:/catalogue:) no longer fail outright in the low-latency runtime; they delegate to the full audio resolver, restoring catalogue track playback.
Fix: catalog SHA-256 now matches the exact 1.10.1 runtime file.
Performance: progressive search and continuation expansion target sub-second first paint and up to 150 results.
Performance: playback routes race in parallel and resolved streams are cached for rapid skipping.
Performance: Home is cache-first with background refresh.
